answer:
Under Rule 6c-11(d) of the Investment Company Act of 1940, an ETF must preserve:

1. **Authorized participant (AP) agreements:** copies of all agreements with APs.
2. **Exchanged-basket records:** records of the composition of each creation and redemption basket exchanged with APs, including the related transaction information.

**Retention:** Records must be kept for at least **five years**, with the **first two years** in an easily accessible place.

This reflects the rule as I understand it. I can't check live sources, so confirm the current text and any post-2026 amendments on eCFR or the SEC website before relying on it for compliance.
